finding.requiredBehavior: Genuine standalone neutral docs/start prefixes stay valid, but prefix and trailing prose must be assessed within full paragraph/list-owner context. Conflicting subject prose abstains. No URL blacklist.

complexityReview: Paragraph context built once per contiguous range, then cached for monotone traversal; repeated multi-link long paragraphs skip direct-prose whole-string checks by link_count. Observed whole CLI scaling approximately linear for selected1000/4000/12000-line controls; no universal complexity proof claimed.
